items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: And we had this boy Adam Page, he was in the St. John Band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was in the St. John Band. And we had this boy Adam Page, he was in the St. John Band. Buster, he was in the St. John Band. Buster Moore? Yeah, Buster Moore. But then when the war come, well they all spit from the St. John and so forth like that. And after that, well the St. John went on and then the spill took some of the remaining, it was from the St. John and he organized.
Oh, I see. It was from the St. John and it went into the Gibson Band?
